description: This Java source file defines the class DeviceConnectionClientFactoryImpl, which is a concrete implementation of the DeviceConnectionClientFactory interface. It creates and manages DeviceConnectionClient instances for a Hono-based system, handling connection lifecycle, client caching, and event bus message handling related to tenant timeouts.

classes.name: DeviceConnectionClientFactoryImpl
classes.description: A factory class implementing DeviceConnectionClientFactory for creating and managing DeviceConnectionClient instances, with connection lifecycle handling and tenant timeout management.

methods.name: DeviceConnectionClientFactoryImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with a given HonoConnection and sets up event bus consumer for tenant timeout handling.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the connection is disconnected by clearing the client cache.

methods.name: getOrCreateDeviceConnectionClient
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached DeviceConnectionClient for a given tenant ID, ensuring connection is active before client creation.

methods.name: removeDeviceConnectionClient
methods.description: Removes a device connection client from the cache based on tenant ID.

methods.name: handleTenantTimeout
methods.description: Handles tenant timeout messages received via Vert.x event bus by closing and removing the associated client.
